title: The Vybes
description: Immersive fantasy resource pack with custom item names, texture, random quotes, and a full item weapon system.
body:
✨ The Vybes Resource Pack
A fantasy-inspired resource pack designed to enhance your Minecraft experience with immersive visuals and refined gameplay elements.
🧾 Overview
The Vybes focuses on improving item names, UI, and textures to make the game feel more alive, engaging, and fantasy-oriented.
✨ Key Features
Enhanced Visuals: Updated textures for many items, blocks, and entities.

Custom Content: Custom item names, random quotes system, and unique splash texts.

UI Tweaks: Improved interface and banner redesigns for better immersion.

Improved Display: Optimized scale and positioning for all items in both 1st and 3rd person.
⚔️ Spear & Tools System
Experience a complete overhaul of vanilla tools and a brand-new Spear progression (Wood to Netherite).

Designed to feel powerful with custom scales (no animations required).

Better "weight" feeling based on material progression.

Optimized positioning for a more realistic combat look.
📌 Requirements
Edition: Minecraft Java Edition

Version: 1.21.11 or higher
📜 Permissions & Credits
Permissions: Free for personal use. Redistribution allowed only with credit. Commercial use is prohibited.

Lead Developer: PQHuy (@Probfix studio)

Support: Minecraft Vietnam Community, OpenAI, Google Gemini
